name: comp-118

frames.best_why: Brightest, cleanest frame with no cursor over the icon, label or count.

tagline: Shows a star outline, the word Star and a grey tally inside a white pill.
summary: A light rounded button that invites a star rating. It groups a star icon, the label Star and a running count into one compact control.
appearance: A pill-shaped light button on a dark stage. Inside, a thin outlined star, the bold word Star in near-black and a smaller grey count sit in one evenly spaced row.
behaviour: The button stays still; only its surface reacts. Hovering shifts the light fill toward grey and pressing deepens it, then it settles back to off-white.
search_phrases: star with a number next to it
white pill with star and number
use_when: A single tap should bookmark, favourite or upvote an item while showing how many others already did.
avoid_when: It is a plain button with no pressed look or counting logic, so you must add that behaviour yourself.
customise: The label, count and icon are written in the file, so changing them means editing the source; button size and variant follow the shared Button defaults.
weight_why: One button with an icon and two text spans; only a colour transition runs.

a11y.note: The star icon is hidden from screen readers and the count reads as plain text; no pressed state is announced.

issues: The count 729 is fixed in the source, so the demo can never change it.
polish_why: Even spacing and a clear split between label and muted count; otherwise flat and generic.
title: Star Count Button
